summary: fix(payments): show prorated upgrade amounts on processing and success
description:
Because
- PurchaseDetails reflected the higher-tier's full price on processing and success until the page was refreshed

This pull request
- Looks up the upgraded subscription by its new price in getCart until checkout saves its ID
- Passes cartState to PurchaseDetails in the upgrade layout so prices refresh on success
- Adds getCart tests for processing upgrade carts without a saved subscription ID

Closes
PAY-3918
